# Support

Need help with styx? Here is where to start:

- **Documentation:** read the [README](../README.md).
- **Bugs:** open an issue with the
  [Bug report](https://github.com/jaoppb/styx/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) template.
- **Ideas and improvements:** open an issue with the
  [Feature request](https://github.com/jaoppb/styx/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)
  template.
- **Security:** follow the [Security Policy](SECURITY.md). Do not use public issues.
